lines.text: Elihu says Job claims he is more righteous than God and asks what benefit he gains apart from sin.
Elihu says he will reply to Job and his wives, and tells him to look at the clouds.
Elihu says Job's wickedness affects only a man like himself, and his righteousness only a son of man.
Elihu says oppressed men cry out and God does not answer, because of the sins of their fathers.
Elihu says God does not listen to empty pleas, and Job multiplies words without knowledge.
